messages:
anna_pm: Quick sync: we need final spec for rerank endpoint (input format, top_k behavior, scoring normalization, truncation) — anyone free now?

mike_eng: I can start. Do we want a single endpoint for both pass-through scores and model-only rerank or two explicit modes?

jia_ml: Prefer explicit modes: 'score_only' vs 'model_rerank'. 'score_only' accepts precomputed scores + returns top_k sorted; 'model_rerank' will score candidates with our reranker.

sam_cs: FWIW customers keep asking for a consistent display range (0-1). Should that be default or opt-in?

leo_se: Implementation proposal: return raw_scores and normalized_scores. Add param 'normalize_scores' (bool) and 'normalization' ('softmax'|'minmax'|'none'). Default: normalize_scores=false.

mike_eng: Performance constraints: default top_k=10, max_top_k=200. Max candidates per request = 1000. For oversized payloads prefer 413 with clear guidance rather than silently truncating.

jia_ml: Normalization details: 'softmax' = stable softmax across provided candidates; 'minmax' rescales to [0,1]. Note: softmax across very large sets can concentrate mass — document tradeoffs.

anna_pm: Launch checklist for v1 beta: public docs + sample code, SDK flags (top_k, normalize_scores, normalization, mode), perf smoke (P95 < 150ms for top_k<=10), 3 customer evals, CS sign-off.

sam_cs: Also request an 'explain' beta flag to return lightweight token-level highlights for top result — optional since it's heavier.

leo_se: Proposed input schema (example):
```
{"query":"...",
 "candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"...","metadata":{}}, {"id":"c2","text":"..."}],
 "candidate_embeddings": [[...], [...]]      // optional, used by model_rerank if passed
 "precomputed_scores": [0.12, 0.05]         // optional, used when mode='score_only'
 "mode":"model_rerank",
 "top_k":10,
 "normalize_scores":false,
 "normalization":"none",
 "explain":false
}
```

leo_se: Response shape: {"results":[{"id":"c2","score":2.3}], "normalized_scores": [0.92], "meta": {"latency_ms":45, "model":"rerank-v1"}}

mike_eng: Example request/response: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
{"query":"how to reset password","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"Reset password steps..."}, {"id":"b","text":"Password reset via email..."}], "top_k":2}

Response:
{"results":[{"id":"b","score":2.3},{"id":"a","score":1.1}], "normalized_scores":null, "meta":{"latency_ms":78}}
```

mike_eng: Notes: return raw float scores (logits) and include 'score_type' in meta ("logit"/"prob"). Server-side normalization available but opt-in.

deploy-bot: Draft RFC created: https://docs.internal/repo/rfcs/123-rerank-api :eyes:

anna_pm: Action items: mike_eng = API PR with schema + errors, jia_ml = normalization tests & perf sims, leo_se = SDK param names + examples, sam_cs = CS beta notes. Target: ship beta in 3 sprints.
